label: GO: choosing a1 after an unrewarded visit to S2
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0; never after a reward), and never when the previous trial reached S1 (prev_state != 1 keeps 100% recall; it fires after an unrewarded S2 visit or on the window first trial). Within that, it fires almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (model_act == 1 / large positive choice logit carries 94% of mass), i.e. the model-based move of heading toward S1 after S2 failed to pay. Only observed variables plus the agent own policy output are used. Does not fire at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, or on a2 choices (6% of mass). Precision is incomplete (0.65 dev): many matching GO steps stay inactive, especially late in the episode (ep_trial >= 85 nearly silent; adding ep_trial < 85 raises dev F1 to 0.79) and at very high value (>8.1 never active). Activation magnitude is larger at the strongest a1 preference (top quartile coverage ~1.0).
